function.name: store_so
function.description: Use this tool for storing service order (SO) information to the database.

additional_info.description: The additional information or instructions that the caller provided on how to get the unit.

chassisType.description: The type of vehicle chassis (e.g., truck, trailer).

contact_name.description: The primary contact person's full name.

customer_id.description: The existing customer's ID to store in the units table

customer_position.description: The position of customer in their company

email_address.description: The customer's email address for contact.

expected_completion.description: The expected completion time for the service.

is_existing_customer_w_new_unit.description: If caller is an existing customer and registered a new unit, then true, otherwise it is false.

is_existing_customer_w_unit.description: If the caller is an existing customer but registered a new unit, then true otherwise it is false.

is_new_customer.description: If caller is a new customer, then true, otherwise it is false.

licensePlateState.description: The state of issuance for the license plate (e.g., 'CA').

marketing_source.description: How the customer hear about our service. (E.g. Google, Friend)

service_complaint.description: The customer's description of the issue or service request.

service_location.description: The full address where the vehicle is currently located.

start_time.description: The agreed-upon start time for the service.

technician_skill_needed.description: The needed skill of a technician to fix the issue

unitSubType.description: The specific subtype of the unit (e.g., dry van, reefer).

unit_id.description: The NEW OR EXISTING customer's unit (vehicle) ID to store in the service_orders table

unit_nickname.description: A friendly name or nickname for the vehicle.

unit_number.description: The new unit number to assign to the vehicle.
